newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS STAY NEUTRAL ON AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS STAY NEUTRAL ON AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists stayed broadly
neutral on the week's outlook for the AEX index of 25 leading
Dutch shares, despite last Friday's scrape to a record closing
high of 571.92, past the previous 571.76 peak set in June.
ING said that the AEX's inability to break above resistance
at the June 6 trading peak of 572.50 showed overhead supply at
that level still weighed heavily on the market.
Fibonacci Press says intermediate trend is still neutral and
the short term trend nearing the end of its up-cycle.
The AEX touched an all-time trading high of 574.25 last
Thursday, while the index finished 6.22 points up on the week.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
ING Barings - Again the AEX has not been able to break above
horizontal resistance at 572.50. It shows that overhead supply
around this crucial chart level still weighs heavily on the
market. The AEX should first retrace a bit before it could try a
second attempt to jump above 572.50.
A running start is needed to breach this resistance.
However, underlying technicals of the AEX remain solid and
sound. Money flow indicators have risen to new all time highs
indicating that liquidity is pouring into the market.
We expect another test of resistance at 572.50 any time
soon. We will upgrade our technical rating for the AEX if the
market closes above 572.50 on heavy volume.
Fibonacci Press - The intermediate term trend is still
neutral and the short term trend is nearing the end of its
up-cycle and should soon roll over causing lower prices.
But as resistance at 571 was taken out, it is still possible
to see some further gains, with resistance around 580,and higher
around 591. A drop below 569 hints that the uptrend is broken,
and confirmed if below 566.
SCE - The Amsterdam market is in an uptrend. The raft of
macro data out of the United States this week will be closely
examined. The support of the dollar and debt markets can
possibly be maintained while technically Friday's record high
closing was a positive development.
As a result it looks as though new ground can be tested.
Possible dips offer good opportunities.
